title: Top 10 Best Reselling Apps in India for 2026
summary: Best reselling apps in India 2026: Meesho, Shopsy, GroMo, EarnKaro and more compared on fees, payouts and realistic profit, with what is actually worth reselling.
body_markdown:
The best reselling app in India for most people is Meesho: zero commission, zero investment, and the platform handles delivery, cash on delivery, and returns while you keep the full margin you set. But the honest answer depends on what you resell, Shopsy wins on Flipkart's logistics, GroMo pays the highest margins per sale because you resell financial products instead of physical ones, and Cashify or OLX win for used goods.


This guide compares the top 10 apps for reselling in India on fees, payout cycles, and realistic profit, explains how reselling actually works, and answers what is genuinely worth reselling in 2026.


## Reselling apps in India: quick facts


Question Quick answer


Best overall reselling app Meesho, zero commission and full logistics support


Investment needed Rs 0 on Meesho, Shopsy, GroMo, GlowRoad, and EarnKaro


Realistic monthly profit Rs 5,000 to 25,000 for consistent product resellers


Highest margin per sale GroMo, Rs 500 to 2,000 per approved financial product


Best for clothes Meesho, Shopsy, and ResellMe


Best for used mobiles Cashify for instant cash, OLX for direct buyers


Fastest payout Meesho's 7-day cycle, EarnKaro withdrawals from Rs 10


## How reselling actually works


Reselling means buying low and selling higher without manufacturing anything. On a modern online reselling app you do not even buy first: you share a supplier's catalog with your margin added, and when someone orders, the app ships directly and pays you the difference.


The Meesho example makes it concrete: a supplier lists a kurti at Rs 250, you share it in your WhatsApp group at Rs 350, a neighbour orders, Meesho packs, ships, and collects the cash, and Rs 100 lands in your bank in the 7-day cycle. No stock, no courier runs, no capital stuck in inventory.


Real resellers doing this consistently, WhatsApp catalogs, Instagram stories, and honest pricing, commonly report Rs 20,000 to 25,000 a month after a few months of building a buyer circle. It is one of the most proven[real ways to make money from home for free](https://gromo.in/blog/real-ways-to-make-money-from-home-for-free/) , and everything runs from a phone.


## Top 10 best reselling apps in India for 2026


App What you resell Fees Payout


1. Meesho Fashion, home, kitchen, beauty Zero commission 7-day cycle, bank


2. Shopsy (Flipkart) Budget fashion, electronics, home Low commission Bank, Flipkart cycle


3. GroMo Financial products: cards, loans, accounts Free, no fees Bank, per approval


4. GlowRoad (Amazon) Fashion, beauty, accessories Free to join Bank


5. EarnKaro Deals from 200+ sites Free Bank from Rs 10


6. ResellMe Fashion from micro-brands One-time signup, then 0% Instant bank withdrawal


7. OLX Used goods, furniture, vehicles Free listings Direct from buyer


8. Facebook Marketplace Anything, locally Free local listings Direct from buyer


9. Cashify Used phones, laptops, gadgets Minimal Instant cash on pickup


10. Quikr Classifieds: electronics, services Free ad posting Direct from buyer


### 1. Meesho, the best reselling app overall


Meesho is where Indian reselling went mainstream: 1.5 million+ registered suppliers, zero commission in every category, no collection fee even on COD orders, and no penalty for cancellations. You keep 100 percent of the margin you set.


**Why it is first:** the supplier network means prices low enough to leave real margin, the app handles packing, shipping, delivery, and COD collection, and payments hit your bank 7 days after delivery. For anyone asking which reselling app to start with, this is the default answer.


**Watch out for:** returns. Fashion return rates are real, and a returned COD order earns nothing, so share honest photos and sizes to keep returns low.


### 2. Shopsy by Flipkart


Shopsy is Flipkart's budget reselling arm, launched in 2021 and aimed at Tier 2 and 3 buyers, with 100 million+ users and Flipkart's logistics behind every order.


**Why it is here:** the Flipkart delivery network is the most reliable in the category, onboarding is paperless, and commissions are kept low. Strongest when your buyers already trust the Flipkart name.


**Watch out for:** margins run thinner than Meesho's on comparable items, check the final payout screen before setting prices.


### 3. GroMo, resell financial products instead of physical ones


GroMo applies the reselling model to a different shelf: instead of kurtis and gadgets, you offer credit cards, savings accounts, personal loans, and demat accounts from banks and NBFCs, and earn a commission on every approved product.


**Why it is third, and first on margin:** one approved credit card pays Rs 500 to 2,000, more than fifty kurti sales' margin, with zero inventory, zero returns, and zero delivery risk. There is nothing to photograph, nothing shipped, and the customer pays nothing, banks fund the commission. Free training in the app covers the products, and the full model is explained in[sell financial products and earn money](https://gromo.in/blog/sell-financial-products-and-earn-money/) .


**Watch out for:** income depends on approvals, not shares. It rewards people who learn 2 or 3 products properly, the same discipline the[commission earning app](https://gromo.in/blog/commission-earning-app/) comparison shows separates earners from browsers. For anyone 18+, it pairs perfectly with a product reselling app: physical products for daily sales, financial products for the big-ticket margins.


### 4. GlowRoad, the Amazon-backed reseller


GlowRoad brings Amazon's backing to social reselling: fashion, beauty, and accessories catalogs with logistics included and free joining.


**Why it is here:** reliable supplier quality control and a clean app for WhatsApp-first sellers. A solid Meesho alternative when you want a second catalog source.


### 5. EarnKaro, reselling without even a catalog


EarnKaro turns deals from 200+ sites, Flipkart, Myntra, Ajio, and more, into your personal profit links. Share a deal, someone buys, you earn the commission. Backed by investors including Ratan Tata, with withdrawals from just Rs 10 in confirmed profit, the same low-friction payout that defines a good[daily withdrawal earning app](https://gromo.in/blog/daily-withdrawal-earning-app/) .


**Why it is here:** the lowest-effort entry into reselling, no pricing decisions, no returns, no customer service, it behaves closer to[refer and earn apps in India](https://gromo.in/blog/refer-and-earn-apps-in-india/) than to true reselling. The trade-off is smaller per-order earnings than true reselling margins.


### 6. ResellMe, fashion from micro-brands


ResellMe connects fashion micro-brands directly with resellers, claims 5 million+ resellers, and charges no commission after a one-time signup fee, with instant bank withdrawals.


**Why it is here:** distinctive inventory your buyers have not already seen on Meesho, which supports better margins in fashion. Factor the signup fee into your first month's math, it is the one paid entry on this list.


### 7. OLX, the used-goods giant


OLX, now part of CarTrade Tech, remains India's default for reselling used goods: 100 million+ downloads, free listings, and direct buyer chat, from furniture to vehicles.


**Why it is here:** flipping used items, buy underpriced locally, sell at market, is the oldest reselling business there is, and OLX has the buyer volume. You handle meetups and payment yourself, so deal in public places and confirm payment before handover.


### 8. Facebook Marketplace


Marketplace turns your existing Facebook account into a local shop with free listings and Messenger chat, no new app to learn.


**Why it is here:** unbeatable for local, bulky, or quick-sale items, and community groups add trust that raw classifieds lack. Like OLX, you manage the transaction yourself.


### 9. Cashify, instant cash for gadgets


Cashify buys used phones, laptops, and consoles with free home pickup and instant payment, 200+ stores across 70+ cities, and it accepts 20+ brands.


**Why it is here:** the best reselling app for mobile phones specifically. Flippers use it as the guaranteed floor price: buy a used phone well, try OLX for the better margin, and Cashify remains the instant exit.


### 10. Quikr


Quikr's classifieds span 1,000+ cities and 50+ categories with free ad posting, from electronics to services.


**Why it is here:** extra reach for the same used-goods listings you put on OLX, at zero cost. List on both, sell wherever the buyer shows up first.


## Which reselling app is best for you?


**The best resell apps each dominate one lane, and the most popular resell apps sort neatly by category. Best reselling app for clothes:** Meesho for supplier depth, Shopsy for delivery reliability, ResellMe for distinctive micro-brand inventory. Fashion is the biggest reselling category in India and all three are built around it.


**Best reselling app in India without investment:** Meesho, Shopsy, GroMo, GlowRoad, and EarnKaro all start at Rs 0. ResellMe's signup fee is the only paid entry, every other pick here is a best reselling app free of joining costs.


**Reselling app work from home:** all ten run from a phone, and reselling ranks among the strongest[online work from home jobs without investment](https://gromo.in/blog/online-work-from-home-jobs-without-investment/) . The sweet spot is Meesho or GlowRoad for daily product sales plus GroMo for high-margin financial products, the combination many homemakers run alongside the ideas in[female business ideas](https://gromo.in/blog/female-business-ideas/) .


**Best reselling app for mobile phones:** Cashify to sell instantly, OLX to maximise price. For reselling new phones and gadgets, Shopsy's electronics catalog is the safer route than grey-market sourcing.


**Best reselling websites in India:** every app here runs a full website too, Meesho, OLX, Quikr, and Facebook Marketplace work identically in a browser, so a laptop-first reseller loses nothing.


## What is most profitable to resell in 2026?


Search and sales data point to five consistently strong categories: women's jewellery sets (the single most searched resale category), ethnic wear and kurtis, beauty and personal care, small home improvement items, and used smartphones.


For used goods, price with the 50-30-10 rule: nearly new sells at about 50 percent of retail, lightly used at 25 to 30 percent, heavily worn at 10 percent. And the highest profit per transaction is not a product at all, a single approved financial product on GroMo out-earns a week of Rs 100 margins, which is why serious resellers run both models side by side, the same stacking logic behind every proven way to[make money online](https://gromo.in/blog/how-to-make-money-online/) .

## FAQ: reselling apps in India


**1. What are the top 10 reselling apps in India?**
Meesho, Shopsy, GroMo, GlowRoad, EarnKaro, ResellMe, OLX, Facebook Marketplace, Cashify, and Quikr. Meesho leads for products, GroMo pays the highest margin per sale through financial products, and OLX and Cashify cover used goods.


**2. Which reselling app is best?**
Meesho for most beginners: zero commission, full logistics, and a 7-day payment cycle. Pick by category instead if you have one, ResellMe for fashion margins, Cashify for gadgets, GroMo for the highest per-sale earnings.


**3. How do I start reselling in India?**
Download one app, complete the simple KYC, pick one category you understand, and share catalogs with your margin added on WhatsApp and Instagram. First sales usually come from your own circle within days, and no investment is needed on the major apps.


**4. What is the #1 money making app?**
For product reselling volume, Meesho. For earnings per action, GroMo, one approved product pays Rs 500 to 2,000 against the Rs 50 to 150 margin of a typical product resale. Most high earners run one of each rather than crowning a single app, the same volume-versus-margin split that runs through all[apps to earn real cash](https://gromo.in/blog/apps-to-earn-real-cash/) .


**5. What is the #1 selling app in India?**
By reseller base and downloads, Meesho, with over a million suppliers and zero-commission economics. Shopsy is the fastest-growing challenger on Flipkart's rails.


**6. Is the ResellMe app safe in India?**
Yes, ResellMe is a legitimate fashion reselling platform connecting micro-brands with resellers. Note its one-time signup fee before joining, unusual for the category, and standard caution applies: confirm current terms in the app, and never pay anyone claiming to unlock extra earnings.


**7. Which resell app has the lowest fees?**
Meesho, with zero commission and no collection fees, GroMo and EarnKaro are also completely free. OLX, Quikr, and Facebook Marketplace list free but leave delivery and payment to you.


**8. What are the best reseller platforms in India?**
For social reselling: Meesho, Shopsy, GlowRoad. For affiliate-style reselling: EarnKaro. For financial products: GroMo. For used goods: OLX, Cashify, Facebook Marketplace. The platform matters less than picking one category and building a repeat-buyer circle.


**9. What is most profitable to resell?**
Women's jewellery and ethnic wear lead product categories, used smartphones lead per-item margins among goods, and financial products lead per-transaction profit overall. Match the category to your network, profit follows trust.


## Disclaimer


Profit figures are indicative ranges based on typical reseller reports as of September 2026, not promises, and your results depend on effort, network, and product choice, they can be zero. Commissions, fees, payout cycles, and platform policies are set by each app and change without notice, verify current terms inside each app before starting. Third-party app names (Meesho, Shopsy, GlowRoad, EarnKaro, ResellMe, OLX, Cashify, Quikr, Facebook and others) belong to their respective owners, inclusion is not an endorsement. This article is for information only and is not financial or business advice. GroMo is available only to users aged 18 and above.
